description: This file is a shell script defining functions and procedures for setting up, configuring, and tearing down a network protocol called 'unet' in OpenWRT. It includes functions for initializing configuration, setting up the protocol with network parameters, and cleaning up with teardown logic, using external utilities like ip and ubus.

methods.name: proto_unet_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the UNET protocol with configuration options such as device, type, auth_key, key, file, keepalive, domain, dht, tunnels, connect, and peer_data.

methods.name: proto_unet_setup
methods.description: Sets up the UNET network interface with parameters obtained from JSON variables and external configurations; creates network device and calls ubus to register the network.

methods.name: proto_unet_teardown
methods.description: Removes the network device and unregisters the UNET network configuration.
